title: CAD Ground-Truth Extraction — Native Parsers, STEP Pipelines, Canonical References
goal: Convert every native CAD file in the 20,006-file corpus into a canonical ground-truth representation (STEP + JSON feature tree + dimensional signature). This is the frozen reference against which PRISM's generated output will be compared in the ultimate test.
ultimate_test_contribution: The ground-truth corpus IS the scoring oracle. When PRISM draws file X from scratch, we compare against ground_truth[X]. Without ground truth, there is no pass/fail signal.

exit_criteria.ground_truth_corpus_complete: All 20,006 files have corresponding ground-truth bundle: {step, feature_tree_json, dimensions_json, screenshots}
exit_criteria.canonical_signature_stable: Re-running extraction produces bit-identical signatures (modulo timestamp fields)
exit_criteria.coverage_report: Report shows % of corpus successfully extracted, broken down by format
exit_criteria.fctstd_native_parser: FreeCAD .FCStd files parseable without launching FreeCAD (ZIP+XML path)
exit_criteria.f3d_sqlite_parser: Fusion360 .f3d files parseable without launching Fusion (SQLite extraction)

units.title: FCStdNativeParserEngine — direct ZIP+XML extraction
deliverables: src/engines/FCStdNativeParserEngine.ts
Parses .FCStd as ZIP archive, extracts Document.xml, GuiDocument.xml, *.brp
Maps object tree, properties, spreadsheet cells without launching FreeCAD
Fallback to FreeCADAutomationBridge for complex feature trees
Handles FreeCAD 0.19, 0.20, 0.21, 1.0 format variations
units.exit: Parses 50 sample .FCStd files with >95% object coverage without launching FreeCAD
units.description: FCStdNativeParserEngine — direct ZIP+XML extraction — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: F3DSQLiteParserEngine — Fusion360 archive extraction
deliverables: src/engines/F3DSQLiteParserEngine.ts
Treats .f3d as ZIP containing SQLite database + binary streams
Extracts timeline, sketch geometry, parameter table without Fusion running
Handles .f3z (multi-file archive) unpacking
Fallback to Fusion360AutomationBridge for baked geometry
units.exit: Parses 50 .f3d files offline with timeline + parameters coverage >90%
units.description: F3DSQLiteParserEngine — Fusion360 archive extraction — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: CADToSTEPPipelineEngine — one pipeline per format
deliverables: src/engines/CADToSTEPPipelineEngine.ts
Orchestrates: identify format → select bridge → open → export STEP → validate
Per-format strategies: .sldprt→SolidWorks, .ipt→Inventor, .FCStd→FreeCAD, .mcx-8→Mastercam, .f3d→Fusion360, .hmc→hyperMILL
Fallback chain: native bridge → STEP-export add-in → manual trigger
Output: normalized STEP AP214/AP242 file
units.exit: Produces valid STEP for 100 mixed-format files; STEP passes ISO-10303 validation
units.description: CADToSTEPPipelineEngine — one pipeline per format — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: GroundTruthFeatureTreeExtractor — canonical JSON feature tree
deliverables: src/engines/GroundTruthFeatureTreeExtractor.ts
Normalizes feature tree across 6 CAD systems into canonical schema
Schema: {features: [{type, name, parameters, sketch?, parent?}]}
Feature type normalization: Extrude, Revolve, Sweep, Loft, Fillet, Chamfer, Hole, Pattern, Mirror, Shell
Handles assembly tree with component references
units.exit: Feature trees for 100 files validate against canonical Zod schema
units.description: GroundTruthFeatureTreeExtractor — canonical JSON feature tree — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: DimensionalSignatureEngine — file → dimensional fingerprint
deliverables: src/engines/DimensionalSignatureEngine.ts
Extracts from STEP: bounding box, volume, surface area, center of mass, moments of inertia
Extracts critical dimensions: hole diameters, thread specs, overall envelope
Produces deterministic hash of dimensional signature for regression comparison
Units normalized to SI (meters, kg, m³)
units.exit: Signature re-computation on identical input produces bit-identical hash
units.description: DimensionalSignatureEngine — file → dimensional fingerprint — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: CADScreenshotCapturer — reference views for visual diff
deliverables: src/engines/CADScreenshotCapturer.ts
Captures 6 canonical views: ISO, front, top, right, section-XZ, section-YZ
Resolution: 1024x1024, white background, no annotations
Uses OCCT viewer (pythonocc) for STEP rendering — bypasses CAD apps for speed
Saves to data/cad-ground-truth/{fileId}/screenshots/{view}.png
units.exit: 100 STEP files produce 6 screenshots each in <5min total
units.description: CADScreenshotCapturer — reference views for visual diff — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: GroundTruthBatchExtractor — 20K parallel extraction
deliverables: src/engines/GroundTruthBatchExtractor.ts
Runs CADToSTEP + FeatureTree + DimensionalSig + Screenshots across 20K files
Reuses CADRegressionTestOrchestratorEngine worker pool
Checkpoint-resumable; produces coverage report (extracted vs skipped vs failed)
Writes to data/cad-ground-truth/{fileId}/
units.exit: 20K-file extraction completes in <8hrs; coverage >85% across formats
units.description: GroundTruthBatchExtractor — 20K parallel extraction — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

Serves as input to training data loader and regression test comparator
units.exit: Registry returns 10-file sample for 'ALCOA lathe parts' in <100ms
units.description: GroundTruthRegistryEngine — indexed, queryable corpus — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: GroundTruthValidationEngine — detect corrupted extractions

Validates each extracted bundle: STEP parses, feature tree well-formed, signature non-degenerate
Flags: zero-volume bodies, missing screenshots, NaN dimensions
Produces QUARANTINE list of files to re-extract or exclude from regression
